whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sone Hotel,

I noticed your hotel has an impressive 1,363 reviews on NH30, Koilwar, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct room bookings and guest inquiries.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, room showcase, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sone

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Sone Hotel, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Sone Hotel) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, room showcase, and location highlights along NH30 in Koilwar. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact room categories, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
